verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online ships a built-in AI assistant, Intuit Intelligence chat. Vendor docs say users can tell it to create invoices, help resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports and estimate tax savings, and can ask it questions about their own data. Specialized agents back this up: Payroll AI collects time data and texts admin updates, and an Intuit-AI invoice generator drafts invoices for review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete as claimed, and in-depth documentation of what the assistant can execute end-to-end versus only suggest, including any approval or review controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Speed up business by telling Intuit Intelligence chat to create invoices, help resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, estimate tax savings, and more.
Ask for the reports that matter most to your business—top expenses, sales trends, industry benchmarking—and get them instantly.
Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees, spots inconsistencies, and texts your admin updates
use our free invoice generator, powered by Intuit AI, to quickly draft personalized invoices for you to review.
